title: I can’t code or draw, and I built a 21-championship motorsport management sim with AI. Here’s what worked and what didn’t.
author: ANMGP_Studio
selftext:
Automotive Empire started as game that I wanted to play but the available in the market and their mods did not provide. 6 months later it simulates 7 racing disciplines, 21 championships running at the same time, and 172 rival teams that develop their cars, poach staff and fight for sponsors just like you.

What worked:

* I habe used Opus for coding, Grok fro images and Suno for the music
* Coding in Opus made it a reality and Grok and Suno made it feel enjoyable and presentable

What didn’t:

* There were times though that the struggle was huge, like coding the pace behind the Safety Car, making the engine understand different racing strategies and identifying when the AI has started to make mistakes. Also, creating racing tracks in Grok, closed loops, is still a huge nightmare.

My job ended up being creative direction: deciding what the game should feel like and rejecting a lot of output until it did.

I am still working in the game, I expect to have it ready in the coming months.

Happy to answer anything about the workflow. Trailer in the comments if anyone wants to see it running.
